channel.title: Talawanda High School News
channel.description: News and announcements from Talawanda High School, including events, athletics, clubs, and important dates.

item.title: Flu and Seasonal Illness Health Reminder
item.description:
The school is experiencing an increase in flu and seasonal illnesses. Keep your child home if they have: fever (100°F or higher), vomiting or diarrhea, significant cough, sore throat with fever, body aches, extreme fatigue, or flu-like symptoms. Students must be fever-free for 24 hours without medication and symptom-free for 24 hours after vomiting or diarrhea before returning to school.

item.title: Kiwanis Chili Supper Fundraiser at THS
item.description:
The Kiwanis Club of Oxford is hosting an all-you-can-eat Chili Supper on Thursday, February 26, 2026 from 5:00-7:00 PM at the Talawanda High School Cafeteria. The meal includes a variety of chili soups with crackers and cheese, cornbread, coleslaw, dessert, and drinks. Attendees can vote for their favorite chili. Suggested donations: Adults $10, Children (6-11) $7, 5-and-under free. Tickets are available from Kiwanis members or at the door. Proceeds support children in the Oxford community.

item.title: Class of 2026 Honors Recognition
item.description:
Class of 2026 students should review the Honors Diploma and Latin Honors lists. The lists include: - Summa Cum Laude recipients (4.2 GPA or higher): 37 students including Sadie Abbitt, John Larson, Katelyn Bulanda, and others - Magna Cum Laude recipients (4.0-4.199 GPA): 27 students including Jake Barkhuizen, Mila Misco, and others - Cum Laude recipients (3.8-3.99 GPA): 22 students including Channing Adkins, Chase Anderson, and others - Ohio Honors Diploma recipients: 35 students led by Halle Sutter

If you believe you met the requirements but don't see your name, contact your school counselor immediately.

item.title: ACT Test Day for Juniors Only
item.description:
Wednesday, February 25th is ACT Test Day for 11th-grade students only at Talawanda High School. Only juniors should report to school that day; 9th, 10th, and 12th graders will not attend. Juniors must arrive by 7:50am to find their testing location and will finish between 11:30am-12:00pm (some may take longer) and need to be picked up at that time.

item.title: Senior Cap and Gown Orders Now Available
item.description:
Jostens cap and gown orders are now open for the Class of 2026. Order online at jostens.com or during in-school ordering at lunch (dates TBD). Deadline to order is December 6, 2025 to receive items within 10 business days. The "Mascot Package" includes cap, rental gown, tassel, and stole for $54.95 (or $66.69 after 12/6/25). Gowns are rentals and must be returned after graduation. Contact tannerj@jostens.com or call (513) 561-3225 with questions. Custom class rings also available.

item.title: Preschool Application Lottery Opens for 2026/27
item.description:
The Talawanda Preschool lottery application for the 2026/2027 school year is now open for typically developing children. Applications must be completed by January 31, 2026, and the lottery drawing will take place on February 13, 2026. Families will be notified of their placement on the roster or waitlist after February 13th. Questions can be directed to Preschool Coordinator Beth Fuechsl at fuechsle@talawanda.org.

item.title: Food Resources Available for Families
item.description:
The Talawanda School District provides multiple food resources for families in need: - Little Free Pantries are available 24/7 outside every TSD building, restocked weekly - Backpack Program provides weekly food bags on Thursdays/Fridays at elementary buildings (contact building Social Worker) - Emergency Food boxes available for pick-up or delivery within 24 hours - Resources include a calendar of community meals and TOPPS schedule, list of all Butler County food pantries, and SNAP information
